title: Multivalent Peptide-Guided EZH2 Degradation Sensitizes Immune Checkpoint Therapy in TNBC.
authors: Li, Minxian; Zhao, Haipeng; Ma, Lilusi; Fang, Qiaojun; Yang, Yanlian; Zeng, Wenfeng; Fang, Xiaocui; Wang, Chen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究多价肽诱导EZH2降解以增强三阴性乳腺癌免疫治疗，虽用MD模拟分析肽与EZH2 SET域结合，但对象为蛋白-肽互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is the most aggressive subtype of breast cancer. Although an immune checkpoint blockade can reduce metastasis, its effectiveness is hindered by the immunosuppressive microenvironment in TNBC. EZH2 is overexpressed in TNBC, and patients with high EZH2 expression are associated with poor prognoses. The study developed EIP103 as a first-in-class peptide degrader that targets EZH2 through multivalent, high-affinity interactions and induces conformational destabilization, representing a mechanism distinct from that of the small molecule inhibitor EPZ-6438. The results demonstrated that EIP103 induces immunogenic cell death through lipid peroxidation, resulting in enhanced immune cell infiltration. Additionally, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and biochemical assays revealed that the peptide EIP103 binds to the SET domain of EZH2, altering its structure and triggering proteasomal degradation via Praja Ring Finger Ubiquitin Ligase 2 (PJA2)-mediated ubiquitination. Harboring both enzymatic inhibition and post-translational regulation properties, EIP103 exerts durable efficacy and activates antitumor immunity, making it a promising therapeutic candidate for TNBC.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是乳腺癌中最具侵袭性的亚型。尽管免疫检查点阻断可以减少转移，但其效果受到TNBC中免疫抑制微环境的阻碍。EZH2在TNBC中过度表达，高表达EZH2的患者预后较差。本研究开发了EIP103，这是一种首创的肽降解剂，通过多价、高亲和力相互作用靶向EZH2并诱导构象失稳，其机制不同于小分子抑制剂EPZ-6438。结果表明，EIP103通过脂质过氧化诱导免疫原性细胞死亡，从而增强免疫细胞浸润。此外，分子动力学（MD）模拟和生化实验揭示，肽EIP103结合EZH2的SET结构域，改变其结构，并通过Praja环指泛素连接酶2（PJA2）介导的泛素化触发蛋白酶体降解。EIP103兼具酶抑制和翻译后调控特性，发挥持久疗效并激活抗肿瘤免疫，使其成为TNBC的有前景的治疗候选药物。
